name: attested-rwa
description: Issue a real-world asset token the network refuses to mint until a quorum of independent attesters signs, then trade it on a KYC-gated SaucerSwap pool.

steps.text: Attested RWA: the token's supply key is a native ThresholdKey of attester keys, its KYC and pause keys are the AssetRegistry contract, and it trades on a KYC-gated SaucerSwap pool. Runs on Hedera testnet.

steps.label: Configure the operator
steps.text: copy .env.example to packages/hardhat/.env and packages/nextjs/.env.local, then fill in OPERATOR_ID / OPERATOR_KEY

steps.label: Seed the demo actors (issuer, attesters, guardian, investors)
Deploy the contracts to Hedera testnet
